responsibilities: Lead the end-to-end delivery of software and digital platform projects, ensuring successful outcomes within agreed scope, budget, quality and schedule. Work closely with software architects and engineers to evaluate solution designs, implementation approaches, technical risks and trade-offs. Coordinate internal and external engineering resources to ensure effective delivery and resource utilisation. Monitor project health, identify risks and dependencies, and drive timely mitigation and resolution. Manage stakeholder communications and provide regular updates on project status, key decisions, risks and milestones. Oversee project governance, documentation, procurement activities and vendor performance where applicable. Ensure software solutions comply with cybersecurity, architecture, operational and organisational requirements. Foster collaboration between multidisciplinary teams including software engineers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity specialists, data professionals and business users. Support tender and procurement activities, including requirements definition, technical evaluations and vendor engagements.
requirements: Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in software delivery, digital transformation, product delivery or technology programme management. Proven track record of leading software development projects from concept through delivery and operations. Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies and modern engineering practices. Demonstrated experience leading Agile software delivery teams using Scrum methodologies. Proven experience facilitating sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives. Strong understanding of Agile metrics such as velocity, burn-down charts, cycle time and release planning. Able to engage confidently with software engineers, solution architects and technical specialists on system design, architecture, integration and delivery considerations. Experience managing vendors, system integrators and multidisciplinary project teams. Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, enterprise software systems and modern application architectures. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, resolve issues and drive delivery in complex project environments. Team player with strong people management, facilitation and conflict resolution skills. Ideal Candidate Profile: The successful candidate is not expected to write code, but should possess sufficient software engineering knowledge and delivery experience to challenge assumptions and proposals from vendors and engineering teams. Understand software architecture and engineering trade-offs. Facilitate productive discussions between business and technical stakeholders. Drive Agile software delivery and project governance. Make informed decisions on delivery risks, timelines and dependencies.

Track record of managing high-stakes operational environments. Proven experience managing vendor relationships, chairing performance reviews, and holding vendors accountable to SLAs. Experience contributing to procurement or contract management activities. Strong experience coordinating release cycles across multiple teams — development, testing, operations, and compliance — with accountability for release readiness decisions. Excellent communication skills. Able to explain technical risks, operational decisions, and compliance requirements clearly to senior leadership, business stakeholders, and regulators. Strong written communication for incident reports, post-mortems, audit RFI responses, and governance documentation. Comfortable working across technical domains without requiring deep hands-on expertise in every platform. Experience with CICD pipelines, release automation, and test management frameworks. Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g. Grafana, ELK stack) from an operational governance perspective. Relevant certifications (e.g. ITIL, PMP, AWS Solutions Architect, or equivalent). description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is Singapore's central bank and integrated financial regulator. MEPS+ (Central Banking & Devt Platforms Division) is responsible for the MAS Electronic Payment System — a mission-critical system supporting interbank payments, government securities management, and domestic market infrastructure. MEPS+ serves the entire Singapore financial sector and requires 24/7 operational reliability, strict compliance with government regulatory frameworks, and close coordination with financial institutions and government agencies. As System Manager, you are the operational and delivery owner for MEPS+ and related systems. You own the outcomes, and coordinate across software engineers, product owners, compliance teams, and external vendors to ensure system reliability, regulatory compliance, and successful delivery of enhancements and patches.

requirements: Trained in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering (Computing), or equivalent practical experience. Experience in delivering large-scale ICT systems across the project lifecycle, including working with vendors or contractors on design reviews, implementation oversight, testing, acceptance, and operational handover, is preferred. Good understanding of cloud architecture, Linux or system administration, networking (VPC/VNet, routing, DNS, TLS), identity and access management, and cybersecurity; experience with containers and Kubernetes would be advantageous. Preferred technical skills include the following areas, and candidates are not expected to be experts in all areas: cloud fundamentals (compute, storage, networking, IAM, encryption/key management, and backup/disaster recovery); operational readiness (monitoring/alerting, incident and problem management, SLO/SLA, runbooks, and capacity and cost management); automation literacy (Terraform/Ansible concepts and Git-based workflows); container orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes); and CI/CD and DevSecOps concepts (pipeline controls, artifact/version management, security scanning, and secrets handling). Relevant certifications would be advantageous, such as Cloud Solution Architect, SysOps, DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes, security certifications such as CISSP, or project management certifications such as PMP or Agile/Scrum. Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership, and able to work independently and collaboratively across teams and stakeholders. Strong written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, analytical, presentation, and negotiation skills, with attention to detail. Willingness to travel overseas occasionally. Your appointment designation will commensurate with your relevant work experience. Successful candidates will be offered a 3-year contract in the first instance and may be considered for placement on a permanent tenure or subsequent contract renewal.

description: You will be part of the Attack Simulation Group (ASG) within the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA), a specialist team responsible for delivering advanced security testing and adversary-led assessments to strengthen the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). requirements: Requirements • An attacker’s mindset with strong technical understanding of operating systems, networks, and modern enterprise environments. • Proven ability to identify and execute real-world attack scenarios, beyond automated or checklist-based testing. • Experience in penetration testing and/or red team operations, with exposure to adversary tradecraft and attack chaining. • Demonstrated adaptability to transfer skills across technical domains (e.g. web to mobile, IT to OT, on-prem to cloud). • Strong technical writing skills and the ability to clearly articulate security risks and impact. • Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in penetration testing, red team operations, or related offensive security roles, with demonstrated depth in hands-on technical work. • Relevant industry certifications such as OSCP, CREST (e.g. CRT, CCT), CRTO, or equivalent are desirable. That said, we recognise that certifications alone do not define capability. Hands-on experience, problem-solving ability, and technical depth matter more to us than badges. If you share our passion to make a difference in the cyber security landscape, take up the challenge and apply now. All applicants will be notified on whether they are shortlisted or not within 4 weeks of the closing date of this job posting. For any issues with the application, you may drop your resume with us at csa_recruit@csa.gov.sg.
description: You will be part of the Attack Simulation Group (ASG) within the Cyber Security Agency of Singapore (CSA), a specialist team responsible for delivering advanced security testing and adversary-led assessments to strengthen the resilience of Critical Information Infrastructure (CII). This is a senior, hands-on role for experienced offensive security practitioners who want to apply real-world attack techniques to complex, high-impact systems in support of Singapore’s national cyber security mission. The Team ASG is a technically driven team within CSA focused on realistic attack simulation, penetration testing, red teaming, and purple-teaming outcomes. Our work goes beyond compliance-driven assurance, emphasising hands-on testing, attacker tradecraft, and practical security improvements. Operating within the realities of government, we value curiosity, adaptability, and out-of-the-box thinking. Specialised training and development opportunities are provided to continuously deepen and expand our technical capabilities, and team members are expected to continuously learn, apply skills across domains, and contribute to the evolution of attack simulation practices across Singapore’s CII. We also believe in sharing and growing our craft where appropriate. Some of our public work and tooling can be found at: 👉 https://github.com/hack-techv2/
